body.name: U
body.def: the canonical orthonormal frame of \(\mathcal S\), obtained by Gram--Schmidt from the first lexicographically ordered \(n\) linearly independent vectors among the orthogonal projections of \(e_1,\ldots,e_d\) onto \(\mathcal S\), with positive first nonzero coordinate
body.role: fixed coordinates on the deterministic common support
